title: universalHomeomorphism_pullback
statement: For a universal homeomorphism u : X' → X and any g : Y → X, pullback.fst g u is universal; its additive upper-star/lower-star adjunction is an equivalence and its cohomology pullback is bijective. The four displayed etale and star base-change isomorphisms exist, and the resulting cohomology square commutes.

proof.text: Stability of universal homeomorphisms under base change makes pullback.fst g u a universal homeomorphism. Apply topological invariance to it: its additive upperStar is an equivalence, so the unit and counit of upperStarLowerStarAdjunction are isomorphisms, and cohomologyMap_bijective gives the asserted cohomology bijections.

Construct set-valued inverse-image compositors by comparing composite sheaf pullback adjunctions using lowerStarComp and leftAdjointUniq. Equivalently use the repaired comparison to inverse sheaf equivalences on the universal-homeomorphism sides. Compose the inverse compositor for pullback.snd g u followed by u with the compositor for pullback.fst g u followed by g, identifying the total morphisms by pullback.condition. This gives the set-valued square isomorphism; upperStarComp gives the additive square isomorphism in the same way.

For a sheaf F on X', insert the inverse counit F → u^*u_*F and apply s^*, where s = pullback.snd g u. Use the inverse-image square s^*u^* ≅ p^*g^*, where p = pullback.fst g u, then apply p_* and cancel p_*p^* by the inverse unit. This constructs p_*s^*F ≅ g^*u_*F, naturally in F, which is the displayed mixed square isomorphism. Every arrow is invertible by topological invariance for u and p. Perform this construction both for sets (using the repaired comparison) and for additive sheaves.

Apply the composition clause of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial to both paths in the pullback square. Apply Sheaf.H.map of the respective inverse upperStarComp to cancel each forward compositor. The two results are pullback along the common composite, identified by pullback.condition, so they are equal as asserted.
